cases.prompt: Audit a SwiftUI media screen containing a fixed-width player, an overlay transport bar, UIScreen.main.bounds checks, and a queue that becomes a second pane at regular width.
must_include: Prioritized findings with evidence locations
Scanner matches treated as candidates rather than proven defects
Navigation-versus-content relationship decision
Compact, regular, fold, accessibility, and fallback verification cases
No file edits

cases.prompt: Recommend how a UIKit mail client can preserve selection while moving between the cover display and a two-pane inner display.
must_include: UISplitViewController for navigation hierarchy
State ownership independent of the current presentation
Safe-area and reserved-region handling only where custom layout needs it
Deployment-target and installed-SDK checks
No invented SDK symbols

cases.prompt: Adapt a SwiftUI drawing app for iPhone Duo in an environment whose installed SDK predates iOS 27.1.
must_include: General adaptive changes that compile with the installed SDK
Preview-only APIs kept out of compiled source
Clear distinction between implemented, verified, and deferred behavior
No claim of Device Hub or pose verification

cases.prompt: Review a continuously scrolling feed whose cells can pass through an active division region while a floating compose button is manually positioned near the fold.
must_include: Continuous scroll content may pass through when the system keeps it usable
The bounded interactive control needs reserved-region-aware placement
No blanket rule that every view intersecting the fold is a defect

cases.prompt: Verify an existing Duo adaptation when only compact and regular simulators are available, not Xcode Device Hub or physical hardware.
must_include: Tests actually run and their results
Duo pose cases explicitly marked unverified
Strongest available resize, state, accessibility, RTL, and older-OS checks
No unsupported claim that the feature is fully validated
